textos.As comparações com outras obras dividem: Comparisons with other works divide the discussion. Among those who recommend it, about half focus on these parallels and value the camp aesthetic with its cult appeal, while many who do not recommend it complain of an uncomfortable, unpleasant feeling while watching.
textos.Design perturbador dos gatos humanoides: Disturbing design of the humanoid cats
textos.O visual híbrido dos gatos com rostos hu: The hybrid look of the cats, with human faces and digital fur, causes deep discomfort, landing in the uncanny valley and making the visual experience quite unpleasant.
textos.A trama é praticamente ausente, se resum: The plot is practically absent, amounting to a succession of musical numbers with no clear connection, with characters being introduced the whole time without the story actually moving forward.
textos.Vários artistas de peso aparecem em papé: Several heavyweight artists appear in roles that do not fit well, delivering lackluster or simply misplaced performances, which reinforces the sense of wasted talent.
textos.O filme gera um mal-estar constante, com: The film produces constant unease, with moments so strange and senseless that one feels like stopping the screening right at the start.
textos.O CGI parece antiquado e mal acabado, co: The CGI looks dated and unfinished, with fake-looking sets and artificial textures that undermine immersion and reinforce the impression of an amateur production.
textos.Algumas canções e vocais se destacam pos: Some songs and vocals stand out positively, but overall the score sounds muted and lacks impact, especially when compared with the stage version.
textos.O visual dos personagens, misturando hum: The look of the characters, mixing humans with felines through CGI, is uncomfortable and often causes a sense of strangeness.
textos.A trilha sonora e as performances vocais: The soundtrack and vocal performances stand out positively, with praise for Jennifer Hudson.

textos.Dirigido por Tom Hooper e lançado em 201: Directed by Tom Hooper and released in 2019, Cats is a production that blends fantasy, comedy and drama. The premise follows the Jellicle tribe of cats during a special night, in which each feline tells its story to the leader in an attempt to be chosen to ascend to the Heaviside Layer and win a new life.
textos.Em termos formais, a obra se organiza po: In formal terms, the work is organized around a continuous succession of musical numbers and choreography, sustained by an aesthetic conception that fuses human and feline traits in specific scenic settings.
textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~86%), a ma: Among the vast majority of ratings (~86%), most criticize the disturbing design of the humanoid cats, pointing out that the digital fusion results in an uncomfortable visual experience. At the same time, a good portion highlights the absence of a clear script and a confusing narrative that is limited to stringing songs together without dramatic progression, while a considerable number stress that the sizable celebrity cast was poorly used in misplaced roles.
textos.De acordo com o público situado em uma f: According to the audience in an intermediate band, present in a minimal fraction of ratings (~7%), many stress the strangeness produced by the look of the hybrid characters. However, a significant share identifies the musical execution as a strength of the production, and a smaller slice views the project's excesses and flaws as something so peculiar that it ends up being entertaining.
textos.Já na perspectiva favorável, reunida tam: From the favorable perspective, likewise gathered in a minimal fraction of ratings (~7%), several see the film as an experience of fun and lighthearted guilty pleasure. Additionally, many stress the technical quality of the dance numbers and the music, while a good portion note the bizarre look and questionable digital effects without this negating the work's appeal.
